test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

After retirement, Jiten Babu took up a position __that is unsalaried__.
solution:
The correct answer is **"honorary."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **"Honorary"** means not paid or not receiving any salary, which perfectly fits the context of the sentence. (अवैतनिक)

 
 
• **Example**: *He is an **honorary**__ president.*
 
 
 
• So, the word **"honorary"** can substitute the underlined segment **"that is unsalaried."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-tenure** refers to a position that does not have job security or a guarantee of employment. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें नौकरी की सुरक्षा या रोजगार की गारंटी नहीं है)
 
• **Substantive** refers to a position that has authority and responsibility. (एक पद जिसमें अधिकार और जिम्मेदारी है)
 
• **Tenure** refers to a position with job security and a guarantee of employment. (नौकरी की सुरक्षा और रोजगार की गारंटी वाला पद)
